role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer, land development (Melbourne)
cover_letter_text:
This is a speculative enquiry, not an application for an advertised vacancy: I am asking whether Breese Pitt Dixon has junior civil drafting or design work available. Your careers page asks for an introduction with a CV and a short note on the kind of work sought. The work I am looking for is drafting and design on the estates, drainage and roads your engineers design.

I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 and hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. In the diploma I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. My portfolio has a road cross section I drew in AutoCAD, with kerbs and drainage. On a community hall renovation in the Philippines in 2019 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements.

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a short call?

Marc Masarate
